params.name: organization-id
params.description: The unique identifier for the Upwind organization.

params.name: per-page
params.description: Specifies how many results are returned on a page.

params.name: page-token
params.description: Specifies the token for fetching subsequent pages in a paginated result set. Use the token from a previous response to continue retrieving data when the number of results exceeds the current page size.

params.name: method
params.description: Filters endpoints by HTTP method (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, etc.).

params.name: authentication-state
params.description: Filters endpoints by authentication state. Multiple values may be provided, separated by commas.

params.name: has-internet-ingress
params.description: Filters endpoints that have internet ingress exposure.

params.name: has-vulnerability
params.description: Filters endpoints that have associated vulnerabilities.

params.name: has-sensitive-data
params.description: Filters endpoints that handle sensitive data.

params.name: cloud-account-id
params.description: Filters by the specified cloud account ID.

params.name: cloud-provider
params.description: Filters endpoints by cloud provider (AWS, Azure, GCP, etc.).

params.name: resource-type
params.description: Filters endpoints by resource type.

params.name: cloud-organization-id
params.description: Filters endpoints by cloud organization ID.

params.name: cloud-organization-unit-id
params.description: Filters endpoints by cloud organization unit ID.

params.name: domain
params.description: Filters endpoints by domain name.

params.name: cluster-id
params.description: Filters endpoints by cluster ID.

params.name: namespace
params.description: Filters by the specified Kubernetes namespace.

items.docs: A `GET` request sent to the endpoint root returns a list of API Endpoint objects that are associated with the specified organization. To learn more about API Security, refer to the [API Security Overview](/api-security/overview) page.

params.name: organization-id
params.description: The unique identifier for the Upwind organization.

params.name: limit
params.description: Specifies the maximum number of items to be returned.

params.name: cursor
params.description: A cursor for pagination to retrieve the next set of results.

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort results by one or more fields. Format: `field` or `field:asc` or `field:desc`. Multiple fields: `field1,field2:desc`. Allowed fields: `first_seen_time`, `last_seen_time`.

items.docs: A `POST` request sent to the search endpoint returns a list of API Endpoint objects matching the supplied search conditions.
